# c-script (Link) — Backend Language with Native End-to-End Type Safety for TypeScript

> c-script is a compiled backend programming language and toolchain with native, zero-IDL isomorphic type safety for TypeScript frontends, embedded SQLite database with live reactive push streaming, declarative RBAC authentication, and integrated testing.

## Documentation & Spec
- [Grammar & Specification](GRAMMAR.md): Complete EBNF grammar, bidirectional type checker, and TypeScript mapping table.
- [Engineering Plan](PLAN.md): Architecture, trade-offs, and roadmap.
- [VS Code Extension](editors/vscode): LSP client and syntax highlighting.
- [Full LLM Reference](llms-full.txt): In-depth cheat sheet and API specification.

## Core Language Features
- **Isomorphic Types**: Structs, enums, unions (`A | B`), generics, closures, and nullable types (`T?`) map 1:1 to TypeScript interfaces, discriminated unions, and JSON.
- **Embedded Database**: `db { collection: Type[] }` creates typed tables on disk in SQLite with `.all()`, `.find()`, `.insert()`, `.applyPatch()`, `.delete()`, `.findWhere()`, `.deleteWhere()`.
- **Reactive Streaming**: `stream endpoint() -> T` over Server-Sent Events (SSE) with `db.<col>.subscribe()`. Consumed as `AsyncIterable<T>` in TypeScript.
- **Declarative Auth**: `@authenticated` and `@requires(Role.Admin)` with 128-bit opaque session tokens.
- **Integrated Test Runner**: `test "description" { ... }` blocks executed with in-memory DB isolation via `linkc test <file.link>`.
- **Full Toolchain**: LSP 2.0 (`linkc lsp`), Formatter (`linkc fmt`), Linter (`linkc lint`), Docs (`linkc doc`), Containerizer (`linkc docker`).

## CLI Quickstart
```bash
# Compile and emit TypeScript contracts, client, validators, and OpenAPI
linkc build backend.link src/gen

# Run built-in test suite
linkc test backend.link

# Start HTTP + SQLite backend server on port 8787
linkc serve backend.link 8787

# Interactive hot-reloading dev mode
linkc dev backend.link src/gen 8787
```

## Example Program (`backend.link`)
```rust
type Todo = {
  id: Int,
  title: String,
  completed: Bool,
  createdAt: Timestamp,
}

enum Filter { All, Pending, Done }

db {
  todos: Todo[],
}

service Todos {
  rpc list(filter: Filter = Filter.All) -> Todo[] {
    match filter {
      Filter.All => db.todos.all(),
      Filter.Pending => db.todos.findWhere(|t: Todo| -> Bool { !t.completed }),
      Filter.Done => db.todos.findWhere(|t: Todo| -> Bool { t.completed }),
    }
  }

  rpc create(title: String) -> Todo {
    db.todos.insert(Todo {
      id: 0,
      title: title,
      completed: false,
      createdAt: now(),
    })
  }

  rpc toggle(id: Int) -> Todo? {
    let existing = db.todos.find(id);
    if existing != null {
      db.todos.applyPatch(id, Todo {
        id: id,
        title: existing.title,
        completed: !existing.completed,
        createdAt: existing.createdAt,
      })
    } else {
      null
    }
  }

  stream watch() -> Todo {
    while true {
      db.todos.subscribe()
    }
  }
}

test "can create and toggle todo" {
  let created = Todos.create("Learn c-script");
  assert(created.id > 0, "ID assigned");
  let toggled = Todos.toggle(created.id);
  assert(toggled != null && toggled.completed == true, "Todo marked as completed");
}
```
